messages:
release-manager: Heads-up: final release cutoff in ~40 minutes (19:00 UTC). Code freeze will be enforced at cutoff; only critical fixes via this thread. When requesting a late-merge exception include: brief risk rationale, CI status, and a one-line changelog.

rachel: FYI I have a tiny fix for dependency loader spam in PR #6110 (one-line guard). Not customer-facing but noisy logs and spamming Sentry. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-infra/pull/6110 :eyes: 

theo: Can you paste the minimal repro or log snippet? Want to be sure it won't affect hot paths.

rachel: Repro log below. Happens when optional deps are missing in env:
```
2026-06-20T18:05:02Z error Loader: Missing optional dependency 'libx'
Traceback: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'libx'
```
Fix just wraps import in try/except and falls back to noop. Unit test added.

qa: Nightly found a related noisy assertion in loader/tests/test_dependency_fallback.py. Marked as flaky but reproducible locally.

rachel: Branch CI is green except for an unrelated timeout in perf/integration-flaky. Re-ran the unit matrix.

devops: Heads-up: infra maintenance 18:50-19:10 UTC; merges during that window may queue. If you need expedited handling ping #eng-infra. :warning:

release-manager: @rachel please file a late-merge exception here with the risk statement. We need approvals from @theo and @miguel + release-bot showing green checks. Also add the one-line changelog (we prefer PR links in changelog).

rachel: Requesting late-merge exception: PR #6110; summary: guard optional dependency import to avoid ModuleNotFound noise and Sentry alerts; scope: single try/except and small unit test; risk: negligible, non-production-path change; CI: branch checks green, unrelated perf timeout only. Changelog: "fix(loader): guard optional dependency import to prevent noisy errors (PR #6110)".

theo: Quick read of diff looks safe. Ran the new test locally. +1

miguel: +1 from me as well. Did a quick staging smoke and saw no regressions.

infra-bot: CI status for PR #6110 - unit: \u2705, lint: \u2705, integration: \u2705, e2e: \u2705 (re-run at 1826004800). All required checks passed.

release-manager: Exception approved. Merge before 18:45 UTC to avoid maintenance queue. After merging, increment patch version in package.json and bump release-manifest tag. Example to follow: 
```
- package.json: "version": "2.4.7" -> "2.4.8"
- release-manifest.yaml: tag: v2.4.8
```

rachel: Merged at 1826004425. Added changelog entry and linked PR in release ticket. Changelog line: "fix(loader): guard optional dependency import to prevent noisy errors (PR #6110)".

infra-bot: Deploy note: merge detected for v2.4.8 candidate. Will schedule release job outside maintenance window.

release-manager: Thanks. Quick reminder: keep PR link in changelog for traceability (product and support ask for it). Also ping me if any other late PRs arrive.

theo: One tiny ask: product wants a short customer-impact sentence in the release ticket (e.g., "reduces spurious error noise seen by onboarding customers"). I added it.

rachel: Done. Closing this thread. :rocket:
